verdict.rationale: Pylon has a dedicated 'Test' page for its Support Agent that lets operators simulate interactions with the AI before deployment. Deployment can also be limited to specific assigned issues, so real-customer exposure is controlled. The story's 'or' is met through simulated conversations, but the evidence is a single short line. Missing for 10: replay or batch testing against historical tickets, detail on test scenarios and scoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I test the agent against historical tickets or simulated conversations before it faces real customers

citations.quote: Simulate an interaction with the AI and see how it handles different questions.
This means you have full control of which customer issues your AI agent interacts with.
